items.s: Hyperscale Data sold 685 bitcoin for approximately $43 million as it reduced debt and funded its Michigan AI data center.

items.h: Ireland’s New AML Strategy Brings ‘Enhanced Checks’ on Private Crypto Wallets
items.s: The country's first strategy of its kind also brings stricter due diligence for firms dealing with overseas crypto companies.

items.h: Norway sovereign wealth fund sees indirect bitcoin exposure hit all-time high, with Strategy accounting for 86%: K33
items.s: Norges Bank Investment Management also disclosed a new $88 million stake in Ethereum treasury firm Bitmine.

items.h: Kraken parent Payward posts $508 million in Q2 adjusted revenue as growth broadens beyond crypto trading
items.s: Kraken parent Payward posted $508M in Q2 adjusted revenue, up 17%, as funded accounts grew 42% to 6.6M and volume fell 13% to $310B.
alt: Kraken parent Payward revenue rises 17% as trading volume falls in Q2

items.h: Gemini posts $108M Q2 net loss despite 37% revenue growth
items.s: Credit card and staking revenue drove Gemini’s services growth in Q2 as exchange revenue fell 38% and trading volume dropped by two-thirds.
